methodology.summary: Closing Line Value (CLV) using real open-to-close line movement from The Odds API's historical endpoint (not a single closing-line snapshot). A play is only recorded when the model shows genuine edge vs. the opening price (moneyline: model win probability exceeds the open-implied probability on that side; total: model total differs from the open total by at least 1.0 point) -- games with no edge get no recommendation, matching the site's own 'if it doesn't clear the threshold, it doesn't make the board' policy.
methodology.data_source: the-odds-api.com historical endpoint, draftkings+fanduel, open snapshot ~5 days before kickoff week, close snapshot ~day-of
methodology.seasons_included: 2024-2025 (completed seasons with real week-to-week line movement)
methodology.excluded: 2026 season is intentionally excluded from this report -- games haven't been played yet, and only near-simultaneous same-day snapshots exist so far (no real open-to-close separation). Live CLV tracking for 2026 begins accumulating now that the odds pipeline is running.
methodology.clv_definition: clv_value = close_implied_prob - open_implied_prob (moneyline, on the recommended side) or the total-line movement in the model's favored direction (total). Positive means the market moved toward confirming the play after we made it -- the standard professional-bettor definition of 'beating the closing line'.
